scope: One small attributed category adaptation and three design references. No upstream workflow framework is installed.

changes: Retained the three upstream category names; added PEER_EVIDENCE and CHECKS.
Used a string-valued Enum and explicit category/key ordering instead of upstream total-order decoration.
Added strict bounded ordinary-builtin records with lowercase SHA-256 values and detached copies.
Hash keyed canonical JSON including map field names and dependency labels.
Return every change, including removed and added entries; absent values are null.
not_reused: Dagster framework, event storage, asset types or staleness resolver
compute_logical_data_version and its unframed concatenated-string hashing

upstream_counterexample.description: The inspected logical version function concatenates code and input version strings and omits input names. Distinct component boundaries can yield identical input bytes before hashing.
upstream_counterexample.local_response: Reject non-digest values, preserve keys and map domains in canonical JSON; tests cover invalid raw splits, valid key-boundary alternatives, domain changes and dependency renames.

design_references.concept: Checkpoint parent/version lineage; external effects require their own idempotency and unknown-outcome handling.

design_references.concept: Replay implementations against saved history; mismatch is a test failure, not a new successful execution.
Immutable subject digests and typed predicates inspire evidence binding; this module is not an in-toto attestation or signature implementation.

existing_retry_policy.note: The previous Eigent adaptation remains separate. This module does not implement retry or dispatch.

public_contract.canonical_encoding: ASCII JSON with sorted keys, compact separators and all keyed body fields; sha256 itself is excluded.

limits: Hashes establish record consistency, not authenticity, identity, authorization, semantic correctness, successful checks or acceptance.
An empty cause list means unchanged recorded inputs; the caller must recheck external source state.
Cause enumeration does not persist a journal, mutate caches, resolve dissent, execute work, or award build/peer-turn credit.
Peer message bodies and private context are not included in this public research ledger.
